title: App-Ads-Mass-Inspector Output
description: Array of compliance results, one per input record, in the same order.

developer_url.description: Verbatim copy of developer_url from the corresponding input record.

is_completely_valid.description: True only when errors_found is empty AND gab_verified is true.

gab_verified.description: True when a syntactically valid google.com DIRECT line with a non-empty publisher_id exists.

errors_found.description: List of human-readable compliance error strings. Empty array when no errors.
